posts.author: Dunkle_G
posts.body:
So I wanted to create some skills in my game that involved having 2 characters use both of their actions that turn to perform a skill together. At first it seemed like something simple to add, but to my knowledge, there's nothing in my plugin list that allows this. (For reference, I have been using VisuStella for the most part. Specifically, I have also been using the OTB Battle System plugin of theirs)
I have a video demonstrating the idea from an old project of mine in RPG Maker VX Ace, where I somehow easily found exactly what I needed.
So far, I do have some JS Code that would allow the game to check if Actor's A and B are in the current party, along with ensuring both spend the appropriate amount of resources for the skill, but that's basically it.
From what I've gathered + learned, I don't really know a way to fully implement this skill into the game with simple JS Notetags, though I have asked a few friends to help me see if it's possible.
Until then though, would anyone here know any plugins at all that would help accomplish this idea, or anything at all, I'd greatly appreciate it.
(Also if I've posted this to the wrong forum, I apologize)
Here's the video showcasing the idea that I mentioned. The first half covers the unified TP Bar used for the idea, which I've already implemented. Now I'm focusing purely on adding in the "requires 2 specific party members" thing now oof.
